entity.title: Policy resolution
entity.description: How the action finds, loads and trusts the policy that governs a pull request.

rules.body: The action MUST read the policy file from the base branch of the pull request, never from its head, so that a pull request cannot change the policy that decides it.
The action MUST resolve an extends reference only when it names a tag or a full commit SHA, refusing a reference to a branch.
The action MUST refuse a policy whose extends chain contains a cycle or is deeper than the documented limit.
The action MUST take no action on a pull request whose policy file does not validate against the published policy schema.
Each policy MUST cite at least one rule identifier of the referenced realm.
The action MUST apply the first policy, in file order after extends are merged, whose match conditions the pull request satisfies.
Every review and log line the action writes for a decision MUST quote the rule identifiers its policy cites.
On a pull request no policy matches, the action MUST take no action beyond withdrawing an approval of its own.
